grade_reason: Her only 2026 remark on AI found is about AI simulations adding to the workload of child predator task forces, which is level D. No statement about catastrophic risk from AI was found since January 2025.
notes: Seven web searches ran; none was refused. Results were thin, so the search may be incomplete. Older AI material on her site (2023 online antisemitism task force meeting with the ADL on AI hazards, a December 2023 Newsweek op-ed with Anthony Housefather, a Wikimedia letter, and a polycystic kidney disease bill directing NIH to plan AI use in research) was not included: it is either before 2025, undated in what I saw, or about non-catastrophic uses; none was checked in detail. Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act (H.R. 10538, Casar, introduced 24 September 2026): sources report 9 or 10 cosponsors but name only Ocasio-Cortez; the Congress.gov cosponsor page returned 403, so whether Wasserman Schultz cosponsored could not be confirmed, though nothing found suggests she did. No House letter about AI risk signed or led by her was found (the many-signer August and September 2026 letters were not searched, per instructions). Quote was verified against the page HTML, including the odd hyphen in 'the-already'.
